name: Switchboard, Patched
tagline: The videotex map of the whole service, patched in: a bezelled glass whose one lit lead runs from the case into the week's NOW lamp, cells parted by engraved seams, and a household index along the foot.
concept: This is the same videotex map, now calmer and joined up. Home opens on the glass case with one sentence in one face, and only "plan." is lit. A pewter jack on the case's bezel sends one short white-hot lead into the Plans rail's NOW lamp, and that lead is the only line drawn on Home. There are no boxes: cells are bare ground with a 3rem tab in their section's ink and contents-line heads, parted by engraved seams, and the two tiers end with their rows. Every inner page shares one head row and ends on an engraved status foot, so the empty Ready tubes fold away and only pages with a live tube keep a rack.
companions: Plans sky #93bfe0: the Plans figure, its day numerals, its tab and "in 2 days" on the next plan. To do sea #86c6bd: To do's figure and tab. Ideas pewter #8794a2: the Ideas tab and figure, the kind word on Home, the compass points on Ideas, the jack's ring and the off rings. On the Ideas register each kind word now wears its kind's grounded ink, the same as its icon (sea, olive, sky, mauve, rose, bone, pewter). Bone #cdc6b5: figures where no section applies, the register's numbers and road times, cost figures on Status, the status foot's words and links. Amber #eaa76b only for late and needs a look: words, the 2px left edge on late rows, the 2px setup edge (now beside them under To do), the 2px edge on Settings' "Sign-in and security" row, and small lamps and bars. Steel #56697b: the rail below the first stop and the edge of older chat replies. The seams' lip is bone mixed 8% into #232a27. The bright #6dff9c stays on the mark, Send and each page's one primary, "plan.", the lead, jack pool and NOW lamps, the lit stretch of the rail, focus, live lamps, the tubes and the row afterglow.
decisions: Title: 'Send Vera anything / to plan.' is one run in Plex Sans Condensed 600 at 2.75rem in --heading. Only 'plan.' is lit, full stop included, with a #eafff1 core and the kit's three-layer halo. 'to plan.' is a nowrap span, so the break before 'to' holds on desktop and on the phone.

The patch lead now sits on the lamp. The NOW lamp draws both the lead (::before) and the jack (::after). The jack sits at the lead's far end, which falls on the case's right bezel. The hard-coded --jack-y and the bezel's .jack span are gone, so a wrapped head or a late font moves the jack and the lead together and they can never drift from NOW. The lead crosses the engraved tier seam, as a patch cord should.

Graft B (Folio's glass status line): under the matte well, in VT323, '4 plans · 3 late · Vera is listening▊'. It holds the case's only cursor. Chat's composer uses the same glass, well, status line and deck.

Graft C (Plate's seams and status foot): a 2px groove over a warm lip between the tiers, between Plans and To do, above Ideas, above the household row, between household cells and under every inner head. The status foot sits on every inner page.

Graft D (Departures' afterglow): pointing at a row lights a 2px phosphor edge, a short bloom and the row's icon or stop at once (60ms), then lets go over 1.5s on a long-persistence curve. Late rows and needs-a-look rows trade their amber edge for the green one while pointed at.

The tiers end with their rows (align-items:start), so the vertical seam is exactly as long as the right tier. Setup moved from under the deck to the foot of the right tier, and To do's '1 with no date' came back as a link on its closing line. Both columns now end within about 5px of each other, with no empty bay beside Lately added. That follows the 14a lesson to add content or shrink the container, never stretch.

One left edge on Home. The heads' lamps no longer hang in the gutter at 19-22px: they sit after the word ('Status ●', 'To do ●', 'Settings ●'), and neutral pin lamps are hidden, so every head starts at the column's 40px edge. Each section's lamp now means something.

The starters are one even row of three keys from the case's outer left edge, set in flex. The first key is unbroken ('What should we do this weekend?') and the other two shrink. Words are Plex Sans 600 at 0.9375rem with 'usually Plans' in Plex Sans 400 0.875rem --dim under them. On the phone the keys stack at full width with the destination on the right, nowrap.
Section tabs appear only over a real head (:has(> .cell-head)), in the section's --cap ink. The stray bone dashes over the Ideas, To do, Plans and Settings tables are gone.

Ideas: the rack is 19rem on Ideas only, so the radar readout fits. The ring legend is one line ('Rings 15m · 45m · 2h') and the names are nowrap with ellipsis. The bloom under the tube's case is dropped but the glass stays lit. Numerals and road figures are bone, compass points pewter.
Plans: the weekend inset fits inside the head band (74-154px against a head of 72-160), with no outer bloom, a 2rem gutter from 'Connect the calendar', and the engraved seam running under both.

Type floor: form labels, rack labels, the Status caption and table heads, the month's weekday heads, the day numerals' weekday and month, the register numbers, month event times, chat times and the scope caption are all 0.875rem now. Labels are 600 in --ink-2. The only 13px text left is the site's legal line, the bar's labels and the status tags.
Form: each label is centred on its field's first line, the row rules between wells are gone, and the 'Everything else' fold lost its two rules, so the form is wells on ground.
Status: the 'By kind of call' table lost its box and now sits under a rule head with a 3rem tab, like the cells above it. Its cost figures are bone.
Settings: needs-a-look is a 2px amber left edge on the 'Sign-in and security' row, the same as To do's late rows. The stray amber bar under the key icon is gone.

Phone: the order is case, deck, starters, Plans (radar hidden, list first), To do, setup, Ideas, household. The Plans head and its Now stop now sit in the first screen, and the next plan sits in the first screen and a half. Less ground above the starters, and the tab no longer cuts into the Plans title.
The empty band under the household and under every status foot is closed (main padding 1rem, footer margin 1rem), which leaves about 2.5rem before the site footer.
Housekeeping: the sheet's head comment was rewritten as the current seven rules of the system. That also keeps the built sheet under the harness's 200,000-character limit (199,769).
title: "Send Vera anything to *plan.*": on Home it sets as "Send Vera anything / to plan." on the glass, with only "plan." (full stop inside) lit. It says FamilyDB's job: anything the family sends (a weekend question, a reminder, an idea to keep) becomes something Vera plans, and the lit word is the job itself.
measures: The full render passes: 0 hard checks failed and 1 guideline missed (the page's words, worst on Plans at 43% different, from the parent's rewording). ink_on_bg 15.15, brand_on_bg 15.28, glow 1.0, screenGlow 1.0. Green share of colour: Home 55.3% (hue entropy .488), Ideas 61.7% (.469, was 63.0%), Chat 47.4% (.476), Status 42.0% (.484). No sideways scroll on any page. The smallest text is 13px, and only on the site's legal line, the bar's tab labels and status tags. Every row label, legend and meta line is 0.875rem or larger. No small targets on Home: the starters, the household cells and the links are 44px or more. CIEDE2000 minimums: kinds 14.3 typical, sections 14.3 typical, deutan 6.5, protan 6.7.
strengths: The patch lead cannot drift any more: the NOW lamp draws both the jack and the lead, so the switchboard's own drawing stays seated on NOW whatever the head does.
Home's two tiers now end together. The seam runs exactly the length of the right tier, setup's amber edge sits beside To do's late edges, and there is no empty bay or band left on the page.

One system on every page: heads start on one edge with meaningful lamps after the word, tabs only over real heads in their section's ink, no boxes (Status's table and the form included), and a single type floor of 0.875rem for every label.
The next plan is now in the phone's first screen and a half, just below the glass.
The starters read as one even row of keys, and the Ideas readout fits its rack on one line each.
Colour is replaced, not removed: the kind words on Ideas take their kind's grounded ink, and numerals and costs are bone, so the register reads warmer without more glow.
weaknesses: Green share is still above the brief's 50% aim on Home (55%) and Ideas (62%). The light lives on the glass and the radar tube, which this line keeps lit on purpose. Bone and pewter are too low in saturation to count against it in the measure.
The coloured kind words on the Ideas register are an addition the brief did not ask for. A judge may read seven grounded inks down one column as edging toward confetti.
The scope's caption under the radar wraps to two balanced lines at 0.875rem.
The weekend inset on Plans is now tight: its VT323 lines are at 1.05-1.25rem to fit the head band, smaller than the other tubes' readouts.
The words differ from today's by up to 43% on Plans, inherited from the parent. This revision changed only 'Rings 15m · 45m · 2h' and brought back '1 with no date'.
The household's Memory cell has no figure and no lamp, so it is the one quiet cell in the row.
revisions: Phone (fix 1): the phone order is now case, deck, starters, Plans, To do, setup, Ideas, household. The ground above the starters is cut (#where:empty hidden, tighter margins), and the Plans tab no longer overlaps its title.

Uneven tiers (fix 2): (a) setup moved into the right tier under 'Every thing to do →'. (b) '1 with no date' is back as a link on To do's closing line. (c) The tiers align to start, so the seam ends with the right tier's last row. (d) The household's min-height is gone and the band before the footer closed to about 2.5rem. The two columns now end within 5px of each other.
Stray tabs (fix 3): tabs are drawn only on modules, cells and panels with a .cell-head, in --cap. Registers carry none.

Ideas (fix 4): the rack is 19rem on Ideas only, with a one-line ring legend and nowrap/ellipsis names. The case bloom is dropped. '#' numerals and road figures are bone, compass letters pewter, and kind words take their kind's ink so the colour is replaced. Green went from 63.0% to 61.7%.
Plans head band (fix 5): the inset is clamped inside the head row, its outer bloom is removed, and the gutter to the primary is 2rem, with the seam running under both.

Desktop starters (fix 6): flex row with the first key nowrap and the others shrinking, from the case's outer left edge. The head lamps came inside the cell, after the word, with the neutral pins hidden, so the left column has one 40px edge.

Type floor and form (fix 7): every label is 0.875rem/1.3 600 in --ink-2, and the month heads, day numerals' weekday and month, register numbers, event times, chat times and scope caption are raised to 0.875rem. Form labels sit centred on their field's first line, and the rules between wells and around 'Everything else' are dropped.

Status and Settings (fix 8): the cost table is unboxed under a rule head with a 3rem tab, and its figures are bone. Settings' needs-a-look is a 2px amber left edge on the row, and the bar under the key icon is removed. The hard-coded --jack-y is replaced by drawing the jack from the NOW lamp itself, the robust form of 'one shared variable'.

Declined, part of fix 7: putting a green 'Add it' primary in the form's head row. A head button would submit a form nobody has filled in yet, and it would mean two 'Add it' buttons. The form's one primary stays where the person finishes filling it. A leader with no figure would only be decoration, so the form's head keeps its title and lede.

Declined, fix 6's alternative: setting the starters' words at --t-small with the destination beside them on desktop. The flex row with an unbroken first key solved the evenness without shrinking the words further.
crit: Phone (home-phone) leaves Plans far below the fold, which fails brief item 14. The DOM order is case, deck, starters, setup, Ideas, then Plans, so a phone stacks Lately added before the next plan. That puts Oaks Park roughly three screens down. Under 64rem, put .map-right (Plans, then To do) before the Ideas cell, with `order` on .page-home .map-col children or by moving Ideas into the source after .map-right. Also cut the gap above the starters on the phone: there is about 70px of dead ground between 'Send where I am' and the first key.

Home's tiers are uneven, and the vertical seam (.page-home .map-right::before) marks the empty bay under To do: about 230px of bare ground beside Lately added, plus another empty band of about 100px under the household row before the footer. Fix it with content and shorter containers, not stretching (14a lesson). (a) Move the setup one-liner from under the deck to the foot of the right column under 'Every thing to do →'. Its 2px amber edge belongs with To do's late edges, and glass still comes first for the eye and for Tab. (b) Bring back To do's '1 with no date' as a link on its closing line. (c) End the seam at the shorter column's last row (bottom: auto, with height set by the content), not at the grid's foot. (d) Close the gap between the household row and the footer to 2.5rem.

Stray section tabs on every inner page. `.board .main>.module::before` (sheet.css line 2219) draws the 3rem bone tab at the top of modules that have no head, so a lone dash floats over the table on Ideas (over '# Idea'), To do (over 'To do / Who / Due'), Plans (under the List/Month keys) and Settings (over 'Part / How it stands'). It reads as a stray underline, like Plate's 'leak'. Draw the tab only over a real head (`.module:has(>.cell-head)::before`, or put the tab on .cell-head itself) and use its section ink (--cap: sky on Plans, sea on To do, pewter on Ideas), never bone on everything.

Ideas: the 17rem rack is too narrow for the tube's VT323 readout. 'Rings: 15 / min, 45 min, / 2 h.' wraps over three lines, and '#7 Pumpkin patch at Bi- / Mart farm' breaks on a hyphen. Either widen the rack to 19rem here, or set the readout under the scope at full rack width with white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis on the names and the ring legend on one line ('Rings 15m · 45m · 2h'). The page is also at 63% green, above the 50% aim. Set the '#' numerals and the 'By road' figures in bone #cdc6b5 and the compass letters in pewter, and drop the soft green bloom under the tube's case (keep the glass lit), so colour is replaced, not removed.

Plans head band: the weekend inset (VT323 'This weekend, 3-4 Oct...') is taller than the head row (about 106px against about 85px). It overhangs the engraved seam, and its outer green bloom sits right next to the green 'Connect the calendar' primary, so two lights compete. Clamp the inset to the head row's height (align-self:stretch; max-height matching the title block) with the seam running under both, remove its outer box-shadow bloom (keep the scanlined glass and the lit '10-11 Oct'), and leave 2rem of ground between the primary and the inset.

Desktop starters: the first key wraps ('What should we do this / weekend?'), so the row of three is uneven and the first key is taller. In .minitel .starters li, give the first key white-space:nowrap and let the others shrink (flex:0 0 auto on the first, 1 1 0 on the rest). Or set the words at --t-small 600 with the destination beside them on the phone only. The keys should also start on the case's outer left edge (40px). The left edges are slightly off: Ideas' head sits at about 37px and its section dot hangs outside the gutter at 22px, as Plans' and the household's dots do. Pull those lamp dots inside the cell (left:0, with the title indented) so the left column has one edge.

Type floor and the form. The page still renders 13px text (form labels 'Title' and 'Suggested by', the Status caption 'By kind of call', the 'Sun' weekday on Home, the month's 'Mon' headers), against brief item 10's 0.875rem minimum. Raise every label to 0.875rem/1.3 600 in --ink-2. On the form (form.png), align each label to its field's first line (align-items:baseline, or padding-top matching the field's) instead of floating low. Drop the row rules between fields, since the fields are already wells, so the form stops being boxes inside rules. Give its head the same row as the other pages (a pewter figure is not needed; the leader and the green 'Add it' primary are).

Status got the least revision, and Settings has nothing lit. On Status, take the box off the 'By kind of call' table (border:0, a rule head with its 3rem tab, as the cells above have) so the page keeps the no-box law, and set the cost figures in bone. On Settings, the amber needs-a-look bar is drawn under the key icon (about 43,274) instead of at the row's left edge. Move it to a 2px amber left edge on the 'Sign-in and security' row, to match To do's late rows. Also replace the hard-coded `--jack-y:4.97rem` on .page-home .map with an offset tied to the Plans head's height (set the Now stop and the jack from one shared variable). Otherwise a wrapped head or a late-loading font drops the lead below the NOW lamp.

firstDraft.name: Switchboard, Patched
firstDraft.concept: The same videotex map as before, now calmer and better connected. Home opens on the glass case with one sentence in one face, only "plan." lit. A pewter jack on the case's right bezel sends one short, straight, white-hot lead across the gutter into the Plans rail's NOW lamp, and that lead is the only line drawn on Home. Boxes are gone. Cells are bare ground with a 3rem tab and contents-line heads, parted by engraved seams. Every inner page ends on an engraved status foot, so the empty Ready tubes fold away and the left rack stays only where a page has a live tube.
